headline: It's 2026. Are you still wearing plastic for your workouts?
body: That sticky feeling after a workout? It's not just sweat. It's plastic. Wearth is made from plant-based fabrics that breathe the way your body does. No microplastics. No synthetic irritants. Just fabric grown from the ground.
reasoning: Sunday evening post-workout golden hour. Mumbai fitness crowd peaks 7-9pm.
